name: heyra-email
description: Email handling for Heyra employees in their own Outlook inbox - triage by urgency and action, replies drafted in your voice, thread summaries and a list of open follow-ups. Knows the house email style, GDPR rules for player data, and which mails to redirect (players, self-exclusion requests, press, retailers). Works in Claude Chat and Cowork with the Microsoft 365 connector, or with pasted text.
